Figure 1: An illustrative example of deliberative collaboration under partial observability. In this menu design scenario, multiple AI agents (e.g., an AI butler and a cooking robot) observe different aspects of the environment, such as ingredient availability and guest preferences, and must exchange information through deliberation to reach a single joint decision. This structure can generalize to other cooperative joint decision problems.
